_comment: Python distributions whose own metadata does not state a usable licence, or where the project chooses one side of an OR. Each entry: the SPDX expression, the evidence (what was read, when), optionally extra_licence_files (patterns relative to the tree root). Keyed by the normalised name, or name==version.

charset-normalizer.evidence: METADATA field License: MIT; licenses/LICENSE, read 2026-11-09

colorama.evidence: METADATA classifier BSD License; licenses/LICENSE.txt read 2026-11-09 (three-clause text)

cycler.evidence: METADATA classifier BSD License; LICENSE read 2026-11-09 (matplotlib project text)

kiwisolver.evidence: METADATA classifier BSD License; licenses/LICENSE ('The Kiwi licensing terms')

tzdata.evidence: METADATA field License: Apache-2.0 (no License-Expression); licenses/LICENSE and licenses/licenses/LICENSE_APACHE in the tzdata 2026.6 wheel (SHA-256 0a10eec6...b4aec, the pin in constraints-hashes.txt), read 2026-11-10. Installed on Windows only
